s: Dine erubin min hattora ubo y"g seipim: min hattora eno chayyab ella keshemmotzi chepetz beraglayv mereshut hayyachid o makniso mereshut harabbim lirshut hayyachid, o sheomed birshut hayyachid vezoreqo o moshito lirshut harabbim o lehepek. Vachakamim aseru hahotzaa vehahaknasa vehazzeriqa vehoshata mikkarmelit lirshut harabbim o lirshut hayyachid, o mehen lekarmelit. Abal meqom petur — muttar lehotzi ulehaknis mimmennu lirshut hayyachid velirshut harabbim umehen letoko, veken lizroq ulehoshit. Abal hammotzi mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim o hammaknis mereshut harabbim lirshut hayyachid derek meqom petur, kegon hammotzi mechanut lirshut harabbim derek istevanit o lehepek — chayyab, kevan shello nach hachepetz bimqom petur. Veap al pi sheholek beraglayv bimqom petur, vahare hinniach raglayv sham bekol pesia — en zo chashuba hannacha ella im ken amad sham lapush, abal im amad sham letaqqen massao, hare amida zo tzorek hilluko veenah chashuba hannacha. Veen tzarik lomar shehammoshit o zoreq mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim o lehepek derek meqom petur, shehu chayyab:

Veken haomed bimqom petur venotel chepetz mereshut hayyachid o miyyad mi sheomed birshut hayyachid venoteno birshut harabbim o beyad haomed birshut harabbim o lehepek, velo nacha yado kelal bimqom petur kesheholikah derek sham — chayyab. Abal im nacha yado sham qetzat — patur. Abal asur laasot ken middibre soperim, apillu al yede shenayim, kegon sheechad omed birshut hayyachid venotel mishsham chepetz umannicho bimqom petur, vehaomed birshut harabbim notelo, mippene shemmezalzel beissure shabbat ligrom lekattechilla hotzaa mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim o lehepek, ugezera shemma yabou lehotzi mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim o lehepek belo hannacha bimqom petur benetayim:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Birshuyyot shel tora, shehen reshut hayyachid ureshut harabbim gemura. Abal birshuyyot shel dibrehem, kegon meqom petur haomed ben b' chatzerot shello erebu, muttar laamod alayv velittol mechatzer zo ulehanniach bechatzer zo. Veken bimqom petur shebben reshut hayyachid lekarmelit, al derek sheyyitbaer besimman (shn"v) [shn"h] (shekkevan sheap birshuyyot shel tora en issur bezeh ella mishshum gezera, im ken birshuyyot shel dibrehem hi gezera ligzera). Veyesh oserim apillu birshuyyot shel dibrehem mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman (shn"g) [shn"b], veyesh lehachamir kedibrehem:

(Vekol zeh kesheomed bimqom petur venaaset sham hannacha, kemo shennitbaer. Veken im omed birshut hayyachid umanniach chepetz bimqom petur, vechozer veoqero mishsham lekarmelit o lechatzer sheenah meorebet. Abal im moshit o zoreq derek meqom petur beli hannacha benetayim — ledibre hakkol asur, shehare kayyotze bazeh birshuyyot shel tora chayyab chattat, laken birshuyyot shel dibrehem asur middibrehem veen kan gezera ligzera). Veyesh mi shemmattir gam bezeh, veen lismok al debarayv, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shn"g. Uledibre hakkol asur lehotzi mereshut hayyachid limqom petur apillu derek reshuyyot shel dibrehem, kegon karmelit o chatzer sheenah meorebet, apillu beli hannacha benetayim, ukemo sheaseru mereshut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid derek karmelit, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shm"z, vehu haddin mikkarmelit lekarmelit derek reshut hayyachid kemo sheyyitbaer sham. Abal mikkarmelit lekarmelit derek meqom petur, muttar tok d' ammot:

Halaka lemosheh missinay shehammaabir chepetz d' ammot birshut harabbim chayyab. Vachakamim aseru lehaabir d' ammot bekarmelit. Abal meqom petur — muttar lehaabir bo bekullo, apillu hu arok elep amma. Umuttar letaltel mikkarmelit zo lekarmelit acheret tok d' ammot, kegon miyyam lebiqa vekayyotze bahen mishshear hakkarmeliyyot:

Apillu maqom shehu reshut hayyachid gemura min hattora, ella shechakamim aseru letaltel bo ella tok d' ammot kemo sheaseru bekarmelit gemura, kegon qarpep yoter mibbet satayim shello huqqap ledira, al derek sheyyitbaer besimman shn"ch, shemmin hattora hu reshut hayyachid gemura apillu arok verachab kamma milin, kevan sheyyesh lo mechitztzot, ella shemmechussar diyyurin, vehazzoreq mittoko lirshut harabbim chayyab — ap al pi ken muttar letaltel mimmennu lekarmelit gemura tok d' ammot, kegon lebiqa haoberet lepanayv. Velo gazeru kan kemo sheggazeru al tiltul mishshear reshut hayyachid lekarmelit, lepi shechasheshu kan im yihyeh asur letaltel mimmennu lekarmelit, yitu lomar shehu en lo din karmelit kelal, veyabou lehattir hattiltul betoko yoter mid' ammot:

Velamma chasheshu yoter leissur hattiltul betoko milleissur hattiltul mimmennu lekarmelit gemura? Lepi shehattiltul betoko matzuy yoter mehattiltul mimmennu lekarmelit gemura, velaken bittelu zeh mippene zeh, shehem ameru vehem ameru:

Velaken muttar liqqach mapteach mikkarmelit shellipne ginna liptoach velinol hagginna, o lehatmino betokah velachazor velittelo mimmenna keshehu omed bachutz, ap al pi shehagginna hi reshut hayyachid gemura min hattora, ella shehi kekarmelit middibre soperim im hi yetera al bet satayim. Ubilbad shello tehe mapseqet benehen isquppa shehi reshut hayachid, kegon shehi geboha asara urechaba d', o apillu enah geboha kelal ella sheyyesh lah mechitztzot min hatztzedadim harechabot d' tepachim, dehaynu mezuzot happetach mikkan umikkan im yesh bahen d', vegam yesh aleha mashqop milmala harachab d', sheyyesh torat tiqra alayv veomerim bo "pi tiqra yored vesotem", ukemo sheyyitbaer besimman shs"a veshas"h, vahare zeh keillu hayeta mechitztza lipne haisquppa, veal yede ken naaset reshut hayyachid, veasur letaltel derek aleha, mippene shemmetaltel mikkarmelit lekarmelit derek reshut hayyachid:

Veim isquppa zo shennaaset reshut hayyachid al yede "pi tiqra yored vesotem" hu lipne reshut hayyachid gemura shemmuttar letaltel betokah, kegon bayit vechatzer — min haddin haya muttar letaltel mehaisquppa lipnim o lehepek, shehare metaltel mereshut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid, ella sheyyesh leesor mishshum sheen hakkol beqiim ledaqdeq im yesh berochab hammashqop d', shekkesheen bo d' en omerim bo "pi tiqra yored vesotem", vahare yesh leisquppa zo din karmelit im enah gaboah asara. Veap al pi sheenah rechaba d', veen karmelit bepachot mid' — hare kol reshut harabbim shellanu hen karmelit, veen meqom petur bekarmelit, ella kol dabar sheyyesh bah apillu en bo d' al d' hu batel etzlah venaaseh kamoha, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"h shekken iqqar. Veap isquppa zo betela etzlah velo etzel reshut hayyachid shebbipnim, hoil veyesh delet mapseqet benehen. Veap bizman shehappetach patuach en haisquppa kelipnim ella kelachutz, hoil vehu asuy lachazor velinnael:

Velaken yesh lizzaher bebayit sheppitcho patuach lekarmelit, shello letaltel min habbayit velachutz raq ad meqom sheqipat haddelet velo yoter apillu mashshehu, ki shemma lo yihyeh bammashqop rochab d' umishsheqipat haddelet veelak hu karmelit. Veap al pi ken en letaltel mehakkarmelit ad meqom sheqipat haddelet mibbachutz, ki shemma yihyeh bammashqop d', veaz kol rochab haisquppa hu reshut hayyachid ap mishsheqipat haddelet veelak. Nimtzeta lamed shehaisquppa mishsheqipat delet veelak kelappe chutz, mattilin aleha missapeq chomer reshut hayyachid vechomer karmelit. (Veken bechalal shealeha ad gobah y' tepachim min haaretz. Abal mi' ulemala hu meqom petur ap bekarmelit) (kemo shennitbaer simman shm"h):

Velaken beotan meqomot sheasur hattiltul sham mechamat sheen sham erub, upetach bet hakkeneset hu letzad harechob, veen sham cheder lipne happetach, vehannokri mebi hammapteach — yesh lehazhir lashshammash shello yiqqach hammapteach miyyado ad sheyyihyeh immo tachat hammashqop sheal happetach, ki shemma tachat hammashqop hu reshut hayyachid, vitaltel mikkarmelit shellipne bet hakkeneset lirshut hayyachid. Al ken yiqqach hammapteach mimmennu tachat hammashqop. Achar kak yiptach hammanul, velo yiptach happetach ad sheyyasir hammapteach techilla, veachar kak yiptach happetach, ki shemma tachat hammashqop hu karmelit, venimtza maknis hammapteach mikkarmelit lirshut hayyachid biptichat happetach lipnim im hammapteach. Al ken yesirennu techilla veyittenennu lehannokri, o yatminehu ben hammezuza lehammashqop o ben hammezuza laisquppa lipne sheqipat haddelet. Abal bemah shemmaknis hammapteach lechor shebbaddelet lepotchah bo — en bezeh mishshum maknis mikkarmelit lirshut hayyachid, ki chor zeh eno kelipnim, hoil vei epshar lehishtammesh bo mibbipnim ella mibbachutz. Vekevan sheen bo d' al d', meqom petur hu. (Ulehaomerim sheyyad haadam shehi geboha lemala mi' tepachim min haaretz hu meqom petur, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shm"z, yakol laamod al haisquppa veliqqach hammapteach miyyad hannokri beod shehu bekarmelit, im yad hannokri hi geboha measara. Veachar kak en tzarik lehasir hammapteach mechoro shebbaddelet terem yiptachenna im chor zeh hu lemala measara mehaaretz, kevan shekkol haabarat mapteach hakkol hu derek lemala measara. Abal kesheyyotze mibbet hakkeneset vesogero — asur lehotzi immo hammapteach derek mala measara letok chalal shettachat hammashqop, ulehatmino sham bechor shehu lemala mi', kevan shenacha qetzat beyado, lepi shellegabbe atzmo eno moil mah shemmotzi lemala measara, kemo shennitbaer sham). Verauy leoto qahal laasot ezeh cheder qatan lipne petach bet hakkeneset, veshub lo yihyeh chashash kelal:

Vekol zeh betachat mashqop sheyyesh lo mechitztzot min hatztzedadim. Abal tiqra sheen lah mechitztzot min hatztzedadim, apillu hi rechaba harbeh — en omerim bah "pi tiqra yored vesotem", kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shs"a, velaken hechalal shettachteha dino legamre kirshut hamhalleket lepanayv (im karmelit — karmelit, veim reshut harabbim — reshut harabbim), veen lehistappeq bechalal shettachteha kelal birshut hayyachid. Velaken tzarik lehazhir meod larabbim shennikshalim begaggin shellanu habboletim lipne habbattim, shemmetaltelim tachtehen mehabbattim, vezehu issur gamur — lo yeaseh ken beyisrael, shehare liblita zo en lah mechitztzot kehilkatan, sheap sheammudim techubim keneged habbayit vehaggag natun alehem, vahare zeh tzurat happetach shehi kimchitztza, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shs"b — mikkol maqom min hatztzedadim en sham mechitztza kelal. Velaken yaamid qaneh echad etzel kotel habbayit miqqatza mizzeh, veqaneh echad miqqatza mizzeh, mekuvvanim keneged haammudim shebbaqqetzavot, veyihyeh haqqaneh im haammud shekkenegdo mitztzad zeh niddon mishshum tzurat happetach, veken betzad hashsheni, veyihyeh tzurat happetach mikkol hag' tzedadim, vekotel habbayit hu mechitztza rebiit. Veap shemmin haddin en tzarik ella g' mechitztzot, ubarebiit omerim "pi tiqra yored vesotem", kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shs"a, mikkol maqom tob lehachamir velachush lidberay haomer sheggam barebiit tzarik ezeh tiqqun. Veim battim rabbim omedim zeh etzel zeh — day lehaamid qaneh echad biqtzeh habbayit haomed miqqatza mizzeh veqaneh echad biqtzeh habbayit haomed miqqatza mizzeh, viarebu yachad kol habbattim. Veyesh mi sheomer sheen tzurat happetach moelet lehattir hattiltul biblita zo shellipne habbattim, hoil vehapparutz shebbah merubbeh al haomed. Abal haiqqar kisbara harishona, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shs"b:
Im gippupim boletim min qetzeh hakkotel kemin ammud, ad pachot mishshelosha samuk laaretz — en tzarik qaneh kelal, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shs"g:
